mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, which may increase infection risk in patients on eplerenone; additionally, methimazole-induced hypothyroidism could alter eplerenone metabolism and potassium handling.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly, assess renal function and serum potassium periodically, and coordinate care between cardiology and endocrinology; consider alternative antithyroid agents if feasible.
